def_en: 2) a small reptile, probably a kind of lizard, which is unclean
2a) perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning is unknown
kjv: ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power(-ful), strength, substance, wealth.
expl: vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard
etim: or (Daniel 11:6) ; from an unused root meaning to be firm;
